label: Rst_3HP system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a three-protein Rst_3HP locus represented by DefenseFinder as a three-profile model requiring Rst_3HP__Hp1, Rst_3HP__Hp2, and Rst_3HP__Hp3 and experimentally linked to P1 protection when expressed in Escherichia coli.
observations: Rst_3HP branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Hp1, Hp2, or Hp3 proteins, the DefenseFinder Rst_3HP__Hp1, Rst_3HP__Hp2, and Rst_3HP__Hp3 profiles, the Rst_3HP source key, P1 resistance outside a complete Rst_3HP locus, unvalidated RefSeq examples, and other Rst or phage-defense systems.
